sentences.en: PIXELIZATION - the graininess in an image that results when the pixels are too big, relative to the size of the image.
sentences.vi: PIXELIZATION - độ hạt trong hình ảnh xuất hiện khi pixel quá lớn, so với kích thước của hình ảnh.

sentences.en: In digital imaging, graininess may occur as a result of printing an image, the pixel resolution of which is too coarse(sentencedict.com), or as a result of using a printer with poor dot resolution.
